name: Space Program
tagline: The room the mission is run from — white flight-checklist plates, one agency blue that acts, and a console of stencils, graduations and status lamps
fonts_label: Big Shoulders Display · IBM Plex Sans · Overpass Mono
use_when: program documentation and control-room surfaces: mission and ops consoles, telemetry and monitoring dashboards, checklists and procedure UIs, engineering and safety tooling, anything that should read as a white drawing sheet with a status lamp ladder rather than a night sky (the dark, hardware-side counterpart is outer-space; this is the room, not the sky)
